label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Nelly Korda’s Majors Award
items.text: Nelly Korda leads the first two majors and earned an LPGA award for the best performance in majors this season.

items.headline: Cam Smith Eyes PGA Return
items.text: Cam Smith said he would consider returning to the PGA Tour if LIV Golf folds in the coming years.

items.headline: Xander Schauffele's $100M Milestone
items.text: Xander Schauffele reached No. 9 on the PGA Tour career money list, joining Tiger Woods, Rory McIlroy, and Scottie Scheffler with over $100 million earned.
